newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 9.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Dec. 9:
WASHINGTON - The United States on Monday will unveil a $2 billion plan to dispose of 50 tons of highly radioactive surplus plutonium from the U.S. nuclear weapons stockpile.
WASHINGTON - Clinton administration officials and congressional Republicans endorsed a Senate advisory panel's conclusions that the government's statistics overstate inflation.
WASHINGTON - Federal officials begin three days of hearings Tuesday on the issue of deciding which critically ill patients should have access to potentially life-saving liver transplants.
ZLATOUST, RUSSIA - Russia's leap from communism to the free market has led to a severely distorted economy, with factory production in a deep depression and still falling.
WASHINGTON - Sales of big screen televisions are skyrocketing, boosted by dramatically lower prices, higher quality and the rapid growth of small-dish direct satellite systems.
